paragraphs.text: The Urlan Wild (ER-lahn) is a highland forest in Stonehaven , the western part of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .
The Urlan Wild is the beautiful northern part of Stonehaven. It is said that to journey across these pristine lands was to remember why Corondor was worth fighting for.
